insight: In 2025 Merge added Agent Handler — production MCP connectors that expose its SaaS integrations as ready tools for AI agents.
name: Merge
tagline: Unified API for B2B integrations — plus MCP tools for AI agents.
description: Merge offers a single Unified API that adds hundreds of product integrations (HR, ATS, CRM, accounting, ticketing, file storage) behind one normalized schema. Its Agent Handler product exposes those same integrations as production-ready MCP connectors, giving AI agents thousands of pre-built, authenticated tools. Engineering teams use it to ship integrations and agent tool-calling without hand-building each connector.
edge: One API spanning hundreds of B2B SaaS integrations across HR, CRM, accounting and ticketing — plus an MCP layer to hand them to agents.
pros: Covers HR, ATS, CRM, accounting, more
MCP tools for agents via Agent Handler
cons: Agent Handler is tool-calls only, no syncs
